fact.text: Honey can last for thousands of years.
A day on Venus is longer than its year.
Bananas are berries, but strawberries are not.
The Eiffel Tower can grow taller in hot weather.
A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance.
Koalas have fingerprints remarkably similar to humans.
Alameda became an island in 1902 when a tidal canal was completed.

quote.text: The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
quote.author: Mark Twain

quote.text: It always seems impossible until it’s done.
quote.author: Nelson Mandela

quote.text: Great things are done by a series of small things brought together.
quote.author: Vincent van Gogh

quote.text: Success is the sum of small efforts, repeated day in and day out.
quote.author: Robert Collier

quote.text: Start where you are. Use what you have. Do what you can.
quote.author: Arthur Ashe

quote.text: Believe you can and you’re halfway there.
quote.author: Theodore Roosevelt

quote.text: Act as if what you do makes a difference. It does.
quote.author: William James
